title: mcp_config
description: Schema for the iterations/NNNN/mcp_config.json artefact produced by the generate_mcp_config hook (Phase 4a P4-01). Format mirrors `claude --mcp-config` documented shape: {"mcpServers": {<name>: {command, args, env}, ...}}. Phase 4a P4-06.

mcpServers.description: Map of server name → server descriptor. Empty object is valid (no MCP servers configured).

env.description: Environment variables for the server process; values must be strings.
